title: iLab at SemEval-2023 Task 11 Le-Wi-Di: Modelling Disagreement or Modelling Perspectives?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a model's ability to predict individual annotator judgments and soft-label distributions using a multi-task learning architecture, which treats each annotator as a separate sub-task. This measures how well the model captures the subjective perspectives, disagreements, and inherent demographic biases of different annotator groups (e.g., Muslim immigrants vs. non-Muslims, varying political ideologies, and gender studies experts) rather than erasing them through aggregated hard labels.
